metadata.description: Agent skills for the vsdev Vintage Story modding CLI, from https://github.com/jgwoolley/vintage-story-wiki

plugins.name: vsdev
plugins.description: All vsdev skills: render models and schematics, manage mods and vs-manifest.json, set up the game files, manage ModDB pages, and search the wiki.

plugins.name: vsdev-render
plugins.description: Render Vintage Story models, schematics and chisel shapes to PNG with vsdev. Use to preview or inspect a shape/schematic file or list a model's animations.

plugins.name: vsdev-mods
plugins.description: Find, install and update other people's Vintage Story mods from ModDB with vsdev. Use for mod search, version checks, installing mods or dependencies, or extracting a mod zip.

plugins.name: vsdev-game-setup
plugins.description: Install and configure vsdev and locate the Vintage Story game, data folder and Mods. Use for dev-environment setup or 'game not found' problems.

plugins.name: vsdev-moddb
plugins.description: Manage your own mods' ModDB pages with vsdev. Use to check an upload, review or diff page sources against the live site, or export a release download site.

plugins.name: vsdev-wiki-search
plugins.description: Search the Nf3t Vintage Story wiki from the terminal with vsdev. Use to look up an item, creature or structure, or find an item code.

plugins.name: vsdev-screenshots
plugins.description: Generate a mod's ModDB banners, card logo and modicon with vsdev from vs-manifest.json. Use to make or batch-update mod screenshots, icons or logos.
